principles.label: How I think
principles.title: How I develop
principles.subtitle: Principles that guide every engineering decision, from commit to deployment.
principles.simplicityDesc: The best solution is the simplest one that solves the problem. Less code, less complexity, fewer bugs.
principles.performanceDesc: Obsessive Core Web Vitals, optimized bundle, lazy loading and efficient queries. Speed ​​is a feature.
principles.reliabilityDesc: Error handling, graceful degradation and observability. Production without surprises, rollback in seconds.
principles.automationDesc: Deploy with one command, automatic migrations, built-in smoke test. If it's repetitive, it's automated.
principles.scalabilityDesc: Architecture that grows with the product. Monorepo, shared packages and patterns that support evolution.
principles.productDesc: Technology at the service of the product. Every technical decision involves the question: does this help the user?
principles.manifesto: It's not about using the newest technology. It's about choosing the right tool for the problem, keeping the code readable, and building something that still works two years from now, not just today.
principles.closing: Writing code is easy. Maintaining code is difficult. Therefore, each line is written thinking about who will read it later.
